properties.site-address: Redhill Railway Station, Princess Way, Redhill
properties.name: RBBCBLR019
properties.notes: Planning permission (13/00848/F) granted 2014-01-09 for the redevelopment of the existing station buildings and carparks to provide a new station concourse, a new A1 foodstore; retail parking spaces; 150 residential units arranged in two apartment blocks; residents parking spaces; flexible use class A1, A2, A3 floorspace; plant space; a combined heat and power plant; green roofs; sustainable transport facilities to include a taxi rank; kiss and ride and new multi-storey carpark to provide commuter car parking; delivery and servicing spaces; cycle spaces. Permission lapsed 2017-01-09.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
